title: Alakh Pandey-led PhysicsWallah (PW) partners with the Indian Navy Welfare and Wellness Association (NWWA) to provide educational support to the families of Indian Navy personnel. | Indian Startup News
text: PhysicsWallah partnered with the Indian Navy Welfare and Wellness Association to provide scholarship support to families of Indian Navy personnel, including full scholarships for families of personnel killed in service and discounts on online and offline programmes for serving and retired personnel families.
author: Indian Startup News
summary: Reports PW's education-support partnership with NWWA and the scholarship benefits offered to Navy personnel families.

title: Physics Wallah founder, billionaire Alakh Pandey arrived at Delhi's Jantar Mantar. | Nikhil Kushwaha
text: The post says Alakh Pandey attended Delhi's Jantar Mantar, called for the Education Minister to speak with students, urged that no cases be filed against students, and said he would personally bear legal costs if a student faced a case.
author: Nikhil Kushwaha
summary: Covers Alakh Pandey's appearance at Jantar Mantar and his stated support for student protesters.

title: Success leaves a trail, and this year, it's brighter than ever. | Anup Agarwal
text: PW Chief Strategy Officer Anup Agarwal congratulates Physics Wallah students and staff on NEET UG 2026 results, attributing the milestone to student effort and the wider PW team.
author: Anup Agarwal
summary: Positive internal leadership post celebrating PW students' NEET 2026 results.

title: Many congratulations to all students and our PW family for amazing Neet 2026 results. | Ankit Gupta
text: Ankit Gupta congratulates students and the PW family for NEET 2026 results and thanks students and parents for trusting PW in their academic journey.
author: Ankit Gupta
summary: Positive post from PW Offline's CEO celebrating NEET 2026 student outcomes.

title: It may not be on the periodic table, but if it ever were, we're pretty sure Mango (Ma) would be everyone's favourite. | PW (PhysicsWallah)
text: A PhysicsWallah company post for International Mango Day using a chemistry-themed reference to mango (Ma).
author: PW (PhysicsWallah)
summary: General official-brand post from PhysicsWallah for International Mango Day.

title: Raise funding from PW (PhysicsWallah)! | Startup India
text: Startup India promotes the PW AI Startup Challenge 2026, held with Startup India and DPIIT, inviting eligible AI startups and student innovators to apply for funding, mentorship and investor access from a ₹10 crore fund pool.
author: Startup India
summary: Announces the PW AI Startup Challenge 2026 and its funding and mentorship opportunity.

title: Dear PW (PhysicsWallah), Is This the Work Culture You Are Proud Of? Alakh Pandey | rajeev kumar
text: Rajeev Kumar alleges that colleagues were publicly humiliated by managers, that concerns raised through internal channels were not addressed, and that he was terminated after speaking up. The post calls for transparency, employee dignity and accountability.
author: rajeev kumar
summary: Critical employee-account post alleging poor work culture and retaliatory termination; these are the author's allegations.

title: 📚 PhysicsWallah takes majority control of UPSC coaching platform Sarrthi IAS with ₹71.81 crore investment | Amay Kumar Gupta
text: The post says PhysicsWallah acquired an additional 11% stake in Sarrthi IAS for ₹71.81 crore, taking ownership from 40% to 51%. It frames the deal as a push into UPSC preparation and notes reported revenue and financial figures.
author: Amay Kumar Gupta
summary: Reports PW's claimed majority acquisition of Sarrthi IAS and expansion in UPSC coaching.

title: Alakh Pandey’s latest initiative sends a powerful message: | Manasa Ramesh
text: The post discusses PhysicsWallah's PW School of Startups initiative and cautions readers to distinguish it from viral claims, including an unverified phone number. It advises relying on PhysicsWallah's official channels for application details.
author: Manasa Ramesh
summary: General post about the PW School of Startups, with a caution about unverified viral contact information.
